title: Stage 06x — Verification Sweep (Compact-QA Fold, 29.4)
description: Combined specialty-QA gate for compact_qa tracks (currently just "quick"). Folds whichever of accessibility-audit (06b), observability-gate (06c), verification-beyond-tests (06d), and performance-budget (06e) the track includes into one dispatch. sections_included records which of the four this run actually covers; every other section stays null. Each populated section's shape is identical to its standalone stage-06[b|c|d|e] schema — this is a track-shape change, not a new gate vocabulary.

sections_included.description: Which of the four specialty-QA sections this dispatch covers, in folded order. Every entry here must have its corresponding section populated (non-null); every section NOT listed here must be null.

accessibility.description: Populated (matches stage-06b's shape) when "accessibility" is in sections_included. Null otherwise.

observability.description: Populated (matches stage-06c's shape) when "observability" is in sections_included. Null otherwise.

verification_beyond_tests.description: Populated (matches stage-06d's shape) when "verification_beyond_tests" is in sections_included. Null otherwise.

performance.description: Populated (matches stage-06e's shape) when "performance" is in sections_included. Null otherwise.
